Gujarati Samaj of San Antonio Diwali Dinner

About this Event

Welcome to the annual Gujarati Samaj Diwali Dinner 2026! Join us for a night of delicious food, cultural performances, and festive celebrations. Come dressed in your best traditional attire and get ready to immerse yourself in the vibrant spirit of Diwali. This is a wonderful opportunity to connect with fellow community members and create lasting memories. Don't miss out on this special evening filled with joy and togetherness. We look forward to celebrating with you!
